sourceRulesScreened.rule: Attack: make attacks legally granted by class and weapon; replacing one attack does not replace the entire Action unless specified.
sourceRulesScreened.finding: This action rule does not by itself authorize an attack against a structure or establish a weapon.

sourceRulesScreened.rule: Sunder attacks an object, shield, armor component, or construct joint using its actual durability system; unspecified durability remains an equipment dependency.
sourceRulesScreened.finding: Sunder supplies no independent attack source, weapon, acquisition, or permission to convert a creature-only spell into object damage.

sourceRulesScreened.rule: An improvised weapon includes any object the user can wield in one or two hands; an object with no resemblance to a weapon deals 1d4 damage of a Director-assigned appropriate type.
sourceRulesScreened.finding: Combined with the explicit Sunder object-target rule, this establishes a plausible attack method if the actor lawfully creates/acquires and can wield the selected object. It does not itself establish Minor Conjuration access at the witness state, object shape/custody, attack roll, or resolution.
